_readme: Stock photos for the photographic cut. Picked via web search while this repo's build environment could not reach the image hosts, so each one must be looked at before rendering. `download` is fetched by fetch-photos.mjs; entries with only `page` must be saved by hand as assets/photos/<slot>.jpg. All three licenses allow commercial use in a video without attribution; credits are kept in CREDITS.md anyway.

pickup.shows: A tote bag hanging on the wall next to a front door.

sharpen.shows: A knife being sharpened on a whetstone. Save by hand (Pixabay has no key-free download URL).

slice.shows: Sliced tomato on a chopping board.
